# eventmodeling fixtures

All written for this engine. The grammar follows the Mermaid event modeling
page (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/eventmodeling.html).

- `inline-fields.mmd`, `shared-data.mmd`, `boundaries.mmd`, `projection.mmd`:
  inline data, named data blocks shared by frames, namespaced reset frames
  with a processor, and a read model fed by several events.
- `cjk.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: CJK names, every entity kind, typed inline data,
  a namespaced reset frame with an explicit relation.
